module_summary: Round-robin arbiter tree: binary tree of 2:1 select nodes steered by a fair round-robin priority register picks one request, forwarding its data/index and routing grant back.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Per-input request vector arbitrated by the tree.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: One-hot grant vector back to the winning input.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Per-input payloads muxed through the tree.

anchors.name: req_o
anchors.why: Output request from tree root, any input requesting.

anchors.name: gnt_i
anchors.why: Downstream grant; propagated down tree, advances round-robin.

anchors.name: idx_o
anchors.why: Index of winning input from root index node.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.rr_q
anchors.why: Round-robin priority register; its bits steer each tree level select.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.gen_levels[*].gen_level[*].sel
anchors.why: Per-node select choosing data, index and grant direction.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.gen_int_rr.gen_fair_arb.next_idx
anchors.why: Fair next priority from masked trailing-zero counts.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.data_nodes
anchors.why: Data mux tree nodes; root drives data_o.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.gnt_nodes
anchors.why: Grant propagation nodes from root down to inputs.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.req_nodes
anchors.why: OR-reduced request nodes; root drives req_o.

anchors.name: gen_arbiter.index_nodes
anchors.why: Winning-index nodes assembled per level; root drives idx_o.

groups.name: Round-robin priority
groups.description: Fair priority update via masked LZCs, stored in rr_q on accepted grant.

groups.name: Arbiter tree
groups.description: Binary 2:1 node tree forwarding request, data, index and back-routing grants.
